description: Bootstrap the npm-workspaces monorepo scaffold, Kiro steering files, shared domain types, and bundled seed dataset. This establishes the whole repo (which becomes the first commit for the Kiro University final exam) in a clean, typechecking state. Greenfield: install deps and set up build as part of this feature.
steps: Create root package.json with npm workspaces: ["shared", "backend", "frontend", "infra"]. Add private:true, Node engine >=20. Add root scripts: "build" (npm run build in each workspace), "test" (vitest across workspaces or per-workspace), "typecheck", "synth" (cd infra && cdk synth), "deploy" (build then cd infra && cdk deploy). Use npm workspaces, not yarn/pnpm.
Create root tsconfig.base.json with strict:true, target ES2022, moduleResolution bundler/node, declaration for shared. Each workspace tsconfig extends it.
Create root .gitignore ignoring node_modules, dist, cdk.out, .env, *.log, coverage, frontend dist.

Create shared/ workspace: shared/package.json (name @mlb/shared), shared/tsconfig.json, shared/src/types.ts defining domain types used by both frontend and backend: Team { id:number; name:string; abbreviation?:string; league:'AL'|'NL' }, GameResult { gamePk:number; date:string; away:TeamSideResult; home:TeamSideResult; seriesGameNumber:number }, TeamSideResult { teamId:number; score:number|null; isWinner:boolean|null }, Series { id:string; round:RoundName; league:'AL'|'NL'|'WS'; high:SeriesTeam; low:SeriesTeam; bestOf:number; status:'scheduled'|'in_progress'|'final'; games:GameResult[] }, SeriesTeam { teamId:number; wins:number }, RoundName = 'Wild Card'|'Division Series'|'Championship Series'|'World Series', Bracket { season:number; updatedAt:string; series:Series[] }, PredictionRequest { seriesId:string }, Prediction { seriesId:string; favoriteTeamId:number; favoriteWinProbability:number; narrative:string; model:string; generatedAt:string }. Export a const TEAMS record keyed by MLB team id for the teams appearing in the 2024 postseason (ids/names from MLB Stats API, with league + abbreviation).

Create shared/src/seed/postseason-2024.json: a bundled Bracket object for the 2024 MLB postseason (used as deterministic fallback when the MLB Stats API is unreachable). Populate with the real 2024 postseason series/results aggregated into the Series/Bracket shape. Include a shared/src/seed/index.ts exporting it typed as Bracket.
Create shared/src/index.ts re-exporting types and seed.

Create .kiro/steering/kiro-university.md: distill the official Kiro University Challenge requirements. Must capture: 1-week challenge, lessons posted Sept 21-24, take-home final exam opens Fri 9/25 and due Mon 10/5 23:59 PDT; it is ONE graded build; a NEW project whose FIRST GitHub commit is on/after Mon Sept 21; scored across 7 required lessons plus 2 bonus; credit tiers (Lessons 1-3: 250 each up to 750; 4-5: 500 each up to 1000; 6-7: 1000 each up to 2000; all 7 completion award 1000; each bonus 250; max 5250); lessons span IDE/CLI/Web surfaces and the user is on Kiro Web; final exam entry form due Mon 10/5. Add a section 'How this project demonstrates the lessons' mapping project artifacts (spec/steering-driven dev, agent hooks potential, MCP/Bedrock integration, IaC, tests, README) to the kind of work the exam rewards. Add inclusion:always front matter.

Create .kiro/steering/product.md: product vision - MLB postseason information summary site. Core: graphical view of postseason status (bracket, series results, standings). Added feature: win/loss prediction with an AI-generated natural-language narrative via Amazon Bedrock. No authentication. Target users and non-goals. inclusion:always front matter.

Create .kiro/steering/tech.md: the approved stack - React+TypeScript (Vite) on S3+CloudFront; API Gateway + Lambda (TypeScript, Node 20); DynamoDB; Amazon Bedrock (Anthropic Claude models); AWS CDK (TypeScript) one-command deploy. Data strategy: MLB Stats API (statsapi.mlb.com, public, no key) fetched by Lambda and cached in DynamoDB, with the bundled shared seed dataset as fallback. Note no live AWS calls in this build; deploy done by user via cdk. inclusion:always front matter.

Create .kiro/steering/structure.md: monorepo layout (shared/backend/frontend/infra), naming conventions, where domain types live (shared), how workspaces reference @mlb/shared, test placement. inclusion:always front matter.

Add placeholder package.json + tsconfig.json for backend, frontend, infra workspaces so `npm install` resolves the workspace graph (full implementation lands in later features). Keep them minimal but valid (name, private, a no-op build/typecheck script) so the root install and typecheck succeed.
Run `npm install` at root to install the workspace graph and verify it resolves. Install dev deps: typescript, vitest at root or per workspace as needed.
acceptance_criteria: `npm install` at repo root succeeds and links the four workspaces (shared, backend, frontend, infra).
`npx tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit` (or shared build) compiles shared/src/types.ts and seed with no TypeScript errors.
.kiro/steering/ contains kiro-university.md, product.md, tech.md, structure.md, each with valid inclusion front matter and content grounded in the fetched University page and approved stack.
shared/src/seed/postseason-2024.json parses as a valid Bracket (import in index.ts typechecks).
verification: From repo root: `npm run typecheck` (or `npx tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit`) exits 0.
List .kiro/steering and confirm the four md files exist.
findings:
Monorepo bootstrapped and verified. VERIFIED: `npm install` exits 0 and links all four workspaces (symlinks in node_modules/@mlb -> shared/backend/frontend/infra). `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build`, and `npm test` all exit 0.

WORKSPACE LAYOUT: npm workspaces [shared, backend, frontend, infra]. Package names @mlb/shared, @mlb/backend, @mlb/frontend, @mlb/infra. All are ESM ("type":"module") and extend root tsconfig.base.json (strict, target ES2022, moduleResolution Bundler, resolveJsonModule, isolatedModules, declaration). backend/frontend/infra are MINIMAL PLACEHOLDERS with a single src/index.ts exporting a *_PLACEHOLDER const; later features flesh them out (frontend sets jsx react-jsx + DOM libs + noEmit; backend/infra set types:[node]).

DEV DEPS at root: typescript ^5.6.3, vitest ^2.1.8, @types/node ^20.14.0. @types/node was REQUIRED at root because backend/infra tsconfig set types:[node]; without it typecheck fails with TS2688.

SHARED EXPORTS (@mlb/shared): main/types point at ./src/index.ts (TS source, consumed directly via Bundler resolution; no prebuild needed by consumers). Exports map: '.' -> src/index.ts, './types' -> src/types.ts, './seed' -> src/seed/index.ts. Intra-package relative imports use .js extensions (index.ts does `export * from './types.js'`). index.ts re-exports all types plus { POSTSEASON_2024, getSeedBracket }.

DOMAIN TYPES (shared/src/types.ts): League='AL'|'NL'; SeriesLeague=League|'WS'; RoundName='Wild Card'|'Division Series'|'Championship Series'|'World Series'; Team{id,name,abbreviation?,league}; TeamSideResult{teamId,score:number|null,isWinner:boolean|null}; GameResult{gamePk,date,away,home,seriesGameNumber}; SeriesTeam{teamId,wins}; SeriesStatus='scheduled'|'in_progress'|'final'; Series{id,round,league:SeriesLeague,high:SeriesTeam,low:SeriesTeam,bestOf,status,games}; Bracket{season,updatedAt,series}; PredictionRequest{seriesId}; Prediction{seriesId,favoriteTeamId,favoriteWinProbability,narrative,model,generatedAt}.

TEAMS const (keyed by MLB Stats API team id, verified against the live API): 110 Baltimore Orioles BAL AL, 114 Cleveland Guardians CLE AL, 116 Detroit Tigers DET AL, 117 Houston Astros HOU AL, 118 Kansas City Royals KC AL, 119 Los Angeles Dodgers LAD NL, 121 New York Mets NYM NL, 135 San Diego Padres SD NL, 143 Philadelphia Phillies PHI NL, 144 Atlanta Braves ATL NL, 147 New York Yankees NYY AL, 158 Milwaukee Brewers MIL NL.

SEED (shared/src/seed/postseason-2024.json): real 2024 postseason aggregated from statsapi.mlb.com, season 2024, 11 series, all status 'final'. In each Series the 'high' seed is the home team of game 1 (home-field advantage). Series ids use pattern `2024-<league>-<roundnospaces>-<highId>-<lowId>` lowercased, e.g. 2024-ws-worldseries-119-147. Results: AL WC Tigers(116) over Astros(117) 2-0, Royals(118) over Orioles(110) 2-0; NL WC Mets(121) over Brewers(158) 2-1, Padres(135) over Braves(144) 2-0; AL DS Guardians(114) over Tigers(116) 3-2, Yankees(147) over Royals(118) 3-1; NL DS Mets(121) over Phillies(143) 3-1, Dodgers(119) over Padres(135) 3-2; ALCS Yankees(147) over Guardians(114) 4-1; NLCS Dodgers(119) over Mets(121) 4-2; WS Dodgers(119) over Yankees(147) 4-1. getSeedBracket(season) returns POSTSEASON_2024 only for season===2024, else undefined.

STEERING: four files in .kiro/steering/ (kiro-university.md, product.md, tech.md, structure.md), each with YAML front matter `inclusion: always`. No em dashes used.

ROOT SCRIPTS: build/typecheck/test run `--workspaces --if-present`; synth -> workspace @mlb/infra synth; deploy -> build then @mlb/infra deploy. infra synth/deploy are currently echo placeholders (CDK wired in a later feature). Placeholder test scripts use `vitest run --passWithNoTests`.

GITIGNORE excludes node_modules, dist, cdk.out, frontend/dist, coverage, .env, *.log, plus scratch _ps2024.json/_bracket.json (removed). package-lock.json IS committed. No live AWS/Bedrock/CDK calls were made.
